ujita.p: [Yādicchakanāma] (pu) CL=7 One who is named Ujita. He offers food to Lord Buddha Sikhī first.
pn: Ujita. A caravan-driver, who, with his friend Ojita, gave the first meal to Sikhī Buddha after his Awakening. Thag-a.i.48.
a: [ယာဒိစ္ဆကနာမ်]
ဥဇိတမည်သော သူ။ သိခီမြတ်စွာဘုရားအား ရှေးဦးစွာ အာဟာရလှူသောသူ။
